Definition: Whether the instant payment system supports business payments to suppliers, vendors, contractors, and other businesses for commercial transactions, procurement, and supply chain payments.
Comments: UNCDF’s Djibouti Payment Infrastructure Assessment notes banks offer digital channels (internet/mobile banking) and there are bulk payments supported via the NPS at BCD, but it does not clearly evidence B2B instant payments; still, existence of interbank transfers and bulk payments suggests businesses can make digital transfers to other businesses through banks. Definition: Whether refugees, asylum seekers, internally displaced persons, migrants, and stateless persons can legally access and open digital payment accounts, and practical barriers or enablers for these populations.
Comments: UNCDF’s Djibouti Payment Infrastructure Assessment indicates migrants may face KYC barriers (example: Salaam diaspora account product requires physical presence in Djibouti to start account opening), implying partial access but not specifically refugee-tailored provisions; no direct evidence was found of refugee-specific KYC exemptions or programs for digital payments.
